decisions.reason: As a very new but niche-adjacent agriculture product with only limited website prominence, it remains uncertain, yet the option value of learning about demand likely still exceeds the cost of keeping it in the range for another year.
A foldable large container fits the firm's core reusable logistics offering and its dedicated product page suggests stronger commercial commitment, so management would likely preserve this option.

Although only mentioned rather than heavily featured, a stackable plastic crate is close to the core product family and can be kept at relatively low incremental cost while market acceptance becomes clearer.

This pallet product appears less strongly backed than the more prominently presented launches, but it still sits within the firm's central pallet portfolio and is likely to be retained while uncertainty remains unresolved.
The spill-retention pallet has a dedicated page and serves a specialized logistics need, making it a credible growth option that management would be reluctant to abandon after only one year.
A plastic pallet with load retainers is well aligned with the firm's reusable transport-packaging capabilities, and its standalone page indicates enough promise to justify keeping it on the market.
